Hawaii Vacation Packing List

Based on the vacation itinerary (June 10-20, 2024), here's what to pack:

Essential Items:
- Swimwear (for beach days, snorkeling, and kayaking)
- Sunscreen (high SPF for tropical sun protection)
- Hiking gear (for Diamond Head hike on June 13)
- Casual outfits (for daily activities and luau)
- Camera (to capture memories of beaches, snorkeling, North Shore, etc.)
- Travel documents (passport/ID, hotel confirmations, activity bookings)

Additional Recommended Items:
- Comfortable walking shoes
- Water shoes (for snorkeling at Hanauma Bay)
- Light jacket or sweater (for cooler evenings)
- Hat and sunglasses
- Reusable water bottle
- Beach towel
- Snorkeling gear (if not renting)
- Waterproof phone case
- Insect repellent
- First aid kit
- Chargers and adapters
- Cash and credit cards
